item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 22/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong today. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be a few rain patches over southern China in the next couple of days. Winds are expected to be weak and the weather will be humid over the coast of Guangdong early next week. The visibility will be relatively low over the region. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, temperatures over the coast of southern China will fall slightly midweek next week.
